mainEntity.name: Which social networks does INXSocial support?

acceptedAnswer.text: INXSocial currently supports Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky and X. Available publishing, feed and analytics capabilities vary by network permissions and account type.

mainEntity.name: Can I schedule multiple posts at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bulk Scheduler lets you prepare multiple media items, captions, destinations and timing rules in one batch workflow.

mainEntity.name: What can I create with AI Content Studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Content Studio supports AI Campaign, Image Post, Carousel Post, Short Video or Reel, and UGC Studio. Video can start from text or an image reference, while saved AI Campaigns can move directly into Bulk Scheduler.

mainEntity.name: Can INXSocial generate a complete social media campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AI Campaign can create 10, 15, 20 or 30-post text, image or mixed campaigns, use optional website grounding, and hand the saved campaign into Bulk Scheduler for final destination and timing choices.
